name: The Sunken Atoll
description: A drowned volcanic ring teeming with life. Rich fishing and a natural laboratory.

name: Whitecliff Coast
description: Sheer chalk cliffs rising straight from the sea.

name: The Caldera
description: A collapsed volcano flooded into a deep blue lake.

name: The Singing Sands
description: Dunes that hum in the wind. Pilgrims have crossed deserts to hear them.

name: Skyreach Pinnacle
description: A solitary spire of rock. Every civilization that has seen it has called it holy.

name: The Everflame Vents
description: Geothermal fissures that have burned without pause for as long as anyone has recorded.

name: The Verdant Basin
description: A sheltered valley of impossible fertility.

name: Wellspring of Ages
description: Waters said to restore the weary. Units that drink here recover fully.
